newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues Offshore to offer 6.8 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues Offshore to offer 6.8 mln shares.

text.p: Bouygues Offshore SA said on Wednesday that it had filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a global initial public offering of 6.8 million shares of its common stock.
"The company has announced an indicated price range of $10.75 to $12.75 per ADS, or 111 to 131 francs per share," Bouygyes Offshore, a unit of Bouygues, said in a statement.

It said that, once the offer was completed, that around 40 percent of its outstanding shares would be publicly held -- and 46 percent if the underwriters' over-allotment option to purchase up to an additional 1.02 million shares was exercised.

Bouygues Offshore is a wholly-owned subsidiary and the sole seller of the shares is Bouygues SA. Around 4.08 million shares will be offered in the United States and Canada and 2.72 million in other countries.
"Shares will be sold in the form of American Depositary Shares, each ADS representing one-half of one share and shares," Bouygues said.
Lehman Brothers is acting as global coordinator of the initial public offering.
Bouygues Offshore is a leading international contractor serving the oil and gas industry. It generated turnover of 3.4 billion francs in 1995 and first-half 1996 sales of 1.8 billion francs.
